articles.title: HIVE buys $58 million Toronto plot for AI facility; shares climb
articles.snippet: The bitcoin mining firm continues on its investment path into AI data centers after raising $115 million to expand its global footprint in the industry.

articles.title: UK proposes near-24/7 settlement to prepare markets for tokenization
articles.snippet: The FCA and Bank of England are seeking feedback on new tokenization guidance and plans to extend operating hours for the UK’s core payment and settlement infrastructure toward near-24/7 availability.

articles.title: Polymarket Users Spur Insider Trading Suspicions With $2.4 Million in Iran Prediction Wins
articles.snippet: Interlinked Polymarket accounts have made millions betting on U.S. military actions in Iran—and won 98% of the time, analysts say.

articles.title: Ethereum Founder Vitalik Buterin Says AI Verification Could Help Secure Crypto Networks
articles.snippet: Vitalik Buterin said mathematically verified software may help protect cryptographic infrastructures as AI improves both code generation and vulnerability discovery.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum ETFs Bleed as Crypto Funds Shed $1.07 Billion, Ending 6-Week Win Streak
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETFs bore the brunt of a geopolitically driven sell-off, CoinShares said, though altcoin funds largely held their ground.
